about: What stats() must give for sampleData(today) from src/sample-data.js. Worked out by hand from the tables in that file; test/store-local.test.mjs asserts them. The first two habits are loose; the last two belong to the routines under `routines`, "Brush teeth" (target 2) to both of them, with one count a day. `summary` is the "N of M habits done" line at the top of Today, which counts each habit once. To see exactly this data in the app, open ?demo=sample with the clock set to noon on `today`.
